name: Step2API
description: StepFun AI Studio (studio.stepfun.com) native CLIProxyAPI plugin. Proxies StepFun Playground models (step-3.5-flash, step-3.7-flash, step-5-preview) via native SSE stream with thinking, tools, multi-account pool and token auto-refresh.
author: WenPaul
